# Determine if Detroit had one of the lowest visitor scores this season
# First, extract visitor scores for games where Detroit was the visitor
visitor_scores = df[df['visitor'] == 'detroit']['score'].str.split(' - ', expand=True).astype(int)
# The first part of the score is the visitor's score
detroit_visitor_scores = visitor_scores[0].tolist()

# Get all visitor scores across the entire season
all_visitor_scores = df['score'].str.split(' - ', expand=True).astype(int)[0].tolist()

# Check if any of Detroit's visitor scores are among the lowest in the season
# We'll consider "one of the lowest" as being in the bottom 25% of all visitor scores
sorted_scores = sorted(all_visitor_scores)
low_threshold = sorted_scores[int(len(sorted_scores) * 0.25)]
answer = any(score <= low_threshold for score in detroit_visitor_scores)
